# ProfileKit

> A full-stack profile view and edit app with form validation, an API
> route, and a simple relational schema, built with Next.js and Drizzle
> ORM.

ProfileKit demonstrates a clean full-stack architecture for a single-user
CMS-style profile: a read-only display page, a pre-filled edit form with
strong client-side validation, and a persistence layer backed by a
relational database.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://profilekit.app/): Read-only profile display.
- [Edit](https://profilekit.app/edit): Pre-filled edit form for updating
  profile details.

## Technical implementation

- **Framework:** Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Forms:** react-hook-form with Yup schema validation
- **Data:** Drizzle ORM over a libSQL-compatible database
- **API:** A Next.js route handler backing profile reads and writes

Source and full documentation: https://github.com/Younique98/profilekit
